---
name: debugging
description: Systematically investigate bugs and errors using repository evidence to identify root causes and reliable fixes.
---

# Debugging Skill

- Reproduce or understand the reported behavior.
- Trace the relevant execution path.
- Inspect inputs, state, outputs, and exceptions.
- Identify the earliest divergence from expected behavior.
- Confirm the root cause with code evidence.
- Check for related failure modes.
- Propose the smallest safe fix.
- Define regression tests.
- Do not guess when evidence can be gathered from the repository.
